data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 inherits from SRC_004 by specializing the general temporal-violation forbidden case into a typed-contract forbidden case, where the inherited synchronous pre-call barrier is narrowed to also enforce exception type fidelity. The inheritance is refuted if SRC_004's mechanism can be satisfied without the typed `LEASE_MISMATCH` contract—that is, if a generic exception or 500 status code returned before the provider call still fulfills the temporal constraint without violating the spirit of the regression suite's false-green guard.
